headline: Mata do Paraíso Scout Park / Plano Humano Arquitectos
context: The construction of the Mata do Paraíso Scouting Park was promoted by the Municipality of Vila Franca de Xira, with co-financing from the Recovery and Resilience Plan (PRR), to address the lack of infrastructure supporting scouting in the municipality.
